column1: # Answers of https://api.osv.dev recorded 2026-11-15, cut down for tests/test_v801_deb_source_matching.py.
# Q: one query (ecosystem, package, version) and the advisory ids it returned.
# A: one affected entry of an advisory (id, ecosystem, package, introduced, fixed, urgency; "-" for none).
# V: a fact of the advisory record itself (id, key, value).
# Left out: three of the seven source packages asked (openssl, busybox, curl), the record dates, and the entries of other packages.
